Whenever good coaches coach, they consider the players’ needs first and try to create the best possible coaching environments for them.  
icoachcricket’s app helps players and coaches have fun, learn the game and leave wanting more.

All players have different needs, understanding their needs helps you meet them at the right time.  Whether you are coaching someone starting the game or working with more advance cricketers, icoachcricket allows you to explore relevant and appropriate practices as well as insight from leading coaches and players and access to regular features on coaching.

Now available anywhere, anytime and to anyone.  The app allows instant access to games and practices supported by instructions, animations and videos in the palm of your hand. 

ECB Coaches Association members can access Wings to Fly, Coaches Matter, Coaching Insight, CA Inspire and Hitting the Seam at the touch of a button.  The forum also allows members to communicate, problem solve and share ideas.

icoachcricket is the home of the All Stars Cricket programme.   Activators can find everything they need for the eight week programme as well as indoor activities for wet weather and additional activities for more ideas.  Activities are accompanied by instructions, illustrations, animations and videos. 

Inspire participation, enhance performance and be part of the ECB’s coaching family.

Start using icoachcricket today!

For more information visit icoachcricket.ecb.co.uk
